title: Integrated communication: Public discourse — the public apology

frames.title: Lesson 119 · Integrated communication: Public discourse — the public apology

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C2):** eu consigo ler, ouvir, falar e escrever sobre pedidos públicos de desculpas a partir de um e-mail, usando exacerbate e uma entonação que soe sincera.

body: Esta aula treina **responder em frases completas (IELTS Speaking, TOEFL Speaking)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.subject: Our error, and what we are doing about it
paras: On Monday our website **wrongly stated** that the east clinic would close in June. That statement was **mistaken**, and I **take full responsibility** for it. **Had** we checked the notice, we **would not have caused** this alarm.
I **regret** that our correction on Tuesday only **exacerbated** the confusion: it was **buried** in a long page, and many of you **never saw** it. **I am sorry** for the worry this has caused.
**Effective immediately**, every correction will appear **at the top** of our homepage, **in plain words**, for at least seven days. **You have my word.**
Yours sincerely, Dr. Helena Prado, Director

items.q: The east clinic will close in June.
The correction made the confusion worse.
Corrections will be published at the top of the homepage.
items.why: at the top of our homepage.

frames.title: Estrutura de um pedido de desculpas público

head: Etapa
Fórmula
Nota
rows: **Had we checked**, we **would not have caused**…
blocks.cap: Estrutura de um pedido de desculpas público

blocks.body: Um bom pedido de desculpas **nomeia o erro**, **assume** a responsabilidade, **explica a consequência** e **promete reparação**. Evite *mistakes were made* (passiva evasiva).
*I’m sorry you feel that way* não é desculpa: transfere a culpa para o outro.

items.s: I take full ___ for the error. (responsibility)
___ we checked the notice, we would not have caused alarm. (had)
Our correction only ___ the confusion. (exacerbate, passado)
___ immediately, every correction will appear at the top. (effective)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.ans: Should we say mistakes were made
items.pt: Devemos dizer que erros foram cometidos?

body: **Set the record straight** — corrigir os fatos
**Wipe the slate clean** — começar do zero
**Hang one’s head in shame** — baixar a cabeça de vergonha
**Should we say mistakes were made?** — Devemos dizer que erros foram cometidos?
**No. We made the mistake, and I take responsibility.** — Não. Nós cometemos o erro, e eu assumo a responsabilidade.

items.label: Ajuste refinado de entonação
items.note: Ajuste refinado de entonação: pequenas variações de altura e de ritmo mudam a atitude (cortesia, ironia, reserva, compromisso) sem mudar as palavras.
words: I suppose that’s one way to put it. ↘↗ (reserva)
Well, that’s ONE way to put it. ↘ (ironia)

prompts.model: I take full responsibility for the error.
Had we checked, we would not have caused alarm.

blocks.task: Write a 6-sentence public apology for a fictional mistake, with responsibility, consequence, remedy and a promise; use exacerbate.
blocks.model: Dear customers, our app wrongly charged some of you twice on Friday. I take full responsibility for the error. Had we tested the update, we would not have caused this. Our first reply only exacerbated the confusion. Every affected account will be refunded within two days. You have my word.

items.why: **mea culpa statement** = declaração de mea culpa.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
